description: Keep one continuous development session across AI coding agents.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: ThreadPort stores sessions on the local file system and runs agent CLIs.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Sessions can be viewed and edited, but agents and verification commands only run in a trusted workspace.
view.sessions.welcome:
Create a persistent development session that can move between AI agents.
[New Session](command:threadport.newSession)
config.context.mode: Context detail level used for agent handoffs. When not set, the project default from `.threadport/config.json` (`threadport config set-default-mode`) applies.
chat.description: Ask about the active ThreadPort session
chat.command.handoff: Draft a sourced handoff for another agent
